papers.title: ARM: An AutoRegressive Large Multimodal Model with Unified Discrete Representations
papers.what: A 7B autoregressive model unifies image understanding, generation, and editing over discrete tokens; reinforcement-learning post-training raises WISE from 0.50 to 0.56 and GEdit-Bench-EN G_O from 5.75 to 6.68, with cross-task synergy between generation and editing.

papers.title: Reasoning for Mobile User Experience with Multimodal LLMs: Task, Benchmark, and Approach
papers.what: UXBench is a 2,000-sample multimodal benchmark over real UI screenshots with eight tasks that demand fine-grained diagnosis of user-experience faults across layout, visual hierarchy, and content consistency.

papers.title: PauseRec: Implicit Reasoning for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
papers.what: PauseRec replaces explicit chain-of-thought with internal pause steps for generative recommendation, reporting up to 6.22% higher accuracy and up to 65% fewer GPU hours in training.

papers.title: LLM-as-an-Investigator: Evidence-First Reasoning for Robust Interactive Problem Diagnosis
papers.what: An agent that collects evidence before committing to a hypothesis, reordering the diagnosis loop so conclusions follow observations and the agent stays robust when its first guess is wrong.
